name: Canvas-Wrapped Over-Ear Headphones
description: A pair of over-ear headphones with circular ear cups about 95 millimetres across wrapped in oatmeal-beige cotton canvas, each cup encircled by one fine top-stitched seam and finished at its outer edge with a slim matte ecru aluminium rim ring separated from the canvas by an even hairline gap, a headband whose outer face carries the same canvas and whose underside is lined with a band of natural cork, matte ecru-painted aluminium yoke arms and slider rails with fine evenly spaced detent notches and a concentric machined pivot at each yoke, and memory-foam earpads covered in warm oatmeal woven textile with an even stitched welt.
materials: oatmeal-beige cotton canvas wrap on the ear cups and headband outer face, natural cork headband lining with genuine granulation, matte ecru-painted aluminium yoke arms, slider rails and cup rim rings with no metallic sheen, memory-foam earpads in warm oatmeal woven textile, flush machined buttons with fine chamfers, a drilled microphone perforation grid on the right cup's lower edge
primaryColors: oatmeal canvas beige, natural cork tan, matte ecru aluminium
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the canvas, cork, rim rings, yoke arms, or earpads; never render a third ear cup, controls on the left cup, a second status light, or a mismatched yoke finish, and never lose the single fine top-stitched seam encircling each cup or the even hairline gap between the canvas wrap and the ecru rim ring; never render brushed copper, bronze, polished chrome, glossy plastic, glossy composite, or protein leather anywhere on this product, and never swap the canvas wrap or the cork lining for smooth painted composite; never render the microphone perforations as a painted smudge or a slot rather than a real drilled grid, never render a proud unchamfered button, and never render uneven cup diameters or an asymmetric headband arc; never reproduce the silhouette, hinge, headband form, or trade dress of any real audio manufacturer's product Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the warm textile register of this product must hold in every frame: oatmeal-beige cotton canvas with a visible woven grain wrapping both circular 95 millimetre ear cups and the outer face of the headband, one fine top-stitched seam encircling each cup, a slim matte ecru aluminium rim ring at each cup's outer edge separated from the canvas by an even hairline gap, a band of natural cork with genuine cork granulation lining the headband underside, matte ecru-painted aluminium yoke arms and slider rails with fine evenly spaced detent notches, a concentric machined pivot at each yoke and no metallic sheen anywhere, oatmeal woven textile earpads with an even stitched welt, and exactly one small status light behind a flush light pipe, two flush chamfered buttons, one drilled microphone perforation grid and one USB-C port in a chamfered cutout on the lower edge of the right cup only, with the left cup entirely plain and unmarked, same cup diameter, headband arc and yoke geometry throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
